details.report: Committed forward fix 2f46146. Centralized append-time lifecycle admission closes end/call/reservation races; resumable reservations retain invocation identity; recovered role attempts and post-navigation settlements remain durable across replay; ledger publication no longer deletes peer temporaries and preserves cleanup failures; recovery reconciliation now uses a typed internal signal rather than message text. Added production-ledger regression coverage for typed conflict losers and live peer temporary preservation. Rebuilt dist. Unified verification passed: build:recorder, typecheck, full suite (388 pass, 0 fail, 5 skipped), git diff --check, and npm pack --dry-run. No unauthorized scheduler, timeout, retry cap, backoff, lock, Recorder-boundary change, or public error taxonomy was added.
